verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents a full public REST API (v3) with OpenAPI 3.1 spec, official TypeScript/Python client SDKs, and concrete endpoints for add/search/memory operations with auth (bearer/API keys), confirmed live and key-gated via runtime probes. Docs are thorough (ingestion, search, memory ops, container tags, quickstart) and independently corroborated by hands-on probes hitting the real API and MCP server; missing for 10: no independent third-party developer review of the API's completeness or stability beyond vendor docs and probes.
